provenance.output_mapping: Native ensemble sigmoid localization output columns 1:11; internal column 0 omitted as in native CLI. Scores retain full precision; native CSV rounds to four decimals.
provenance.decision_policy: Native strict thresholds; if none selected, argsort of four-decimal-rounded probability minus threshold selects the final class.
provenance.license: User-provided licensed standalone package; not redistributed

configuration.selection_criteria: Accession-ordered first 30 independent representatives meeting the frozen protocol; no attribution-based selection
